function.arguments:
{"path": "retrieval_performance.py", "content": "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data: Recall@10 (%) for dense retrieval systems on three QA datasets
datasets = ['NaturalQuestions', 'TriviaQA', 'WebQ']
methods = ['BM25', 'DPR', 'Contriever', 'BGE']

# Performance data
data = {
    'BM25': [59.1, 66.8, 55.2],
    'DPR': [79.4, 79.8, 73.6],
    'Contriever': [84.2, 83.9, 79.3],
    'BGE': [88.5, 87.4, 84.1]
}

# Convert to arrays for plotting
x = np.arange(len(datasets))
width = 0.2

# Create the figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Colors for each method
colors = ['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#2ecc71', '#9b59b6']

# Plot bars for each method
for i, method in enumerate(methods):
    ax.bar(x + i * width, data[method], width, label=method, color=colors[i], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)

# Customize the plot
ax.set_xlabel('Dataset', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Recall@10 (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Retrieval Performance (Recall@10) of Dense Retrieval Systems\nAcross Three QA Datasets', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(x + width * 1.5)
ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, fontsize=11)
ax.legend(title='Method', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(45, 95)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on top of each bar
for i, method in enumerate(methods):
    for j, val in enumerate(data[method]):
        ax.text(x[j] + i * width, val + 0.5, f'{val:.1f}', 
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# Add annotation highlighting BM25 lag
ax.annotate('BM25 consistently lags behind\nneural methods', 
            xy=(0.5, 55), xytext=(0.5, 48),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='red', lw=2),
            fontsize=10, color='red', fontweight='bold',
            ha='center', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor='red'))

# Add annotation highlighting BGE best performance
ax.annotate('BGE achieves best results\nacross all datasets', 
            xy=(2.5, 89), xytext=(2.5, 92),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='green', lw=2),
            fontsize=10, color='green', fontweight='bold',
            ha='center', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor='green'))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('retrieval_performance.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Plot saved as 'retrieval_performance.png'")"}
